asset_cleanup_lease_check.name: asset_cleanup_lease_check
asset_cleanup_lease_check.value: ("asset_cleanup_jobs"."state" = 'leased') = ("asset_cleanup_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_cleanup_jobs"."leased_until" IS NOT NULL)

asset_lifecycle_jobs_lease_check.name: asset_lifecycle_jobs_lease_check
asset_lifecycle_jobs_lease_check.value: ("asset_lifecycle_jobs"."state" = 'leased') = ("asset_lifecycle_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_lifecycle_jobs"."leased_until" IS NOT NULL)

assessment_completion_check.name: assessment_completion_check
assessment_completion_check.value: ("assessment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."answers" IS NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."result" IS NULL) OR ("assessment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."answers" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."result" IS NOT NULL)

entitlements_seats_holder_check.name: entitlements_seats_holder_check
entitlements_seats_holder_check.value: "entitlements"."seats" IS NULL OR "entitlements"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

organization_accounts_verified_check.name: organization_accounts_verified_check
organization_accounts_verified_check.value: "organization_accounts"."verification" <> 'verified' OR ("organization_accounts"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_accounts"."legal_name" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_accounts"."kind" <> 'community')
